paragraphs.source_en: Anyone ignorant of the circumstances might have thought that Ieyasu had never regarded Osaka as a serious concern at all. It even appeared that Ieyasu had deliberately come to the capital to seize this opportunity to reform domestic government and discipline its officials.

In stark contrast to the discipline of the Kantō forces, Osaka's armies made a particularly ugly spectacle. The rōnin who claimed to have gathered in defense of Osaka ran roughshod everywhere under the pretext of raising war funds.
